data.locator: Management options, lines 72-88; Referral and follow-up requirements, lines 90-90.
data.source_setting: New South Wales Health Emergency Care Institute ED clinical tool; adult Colles fracture.
data.source_n: Not applicable; clinical guidance, no patient cohort.
data.quantity: Selected source criteria for orthopedic review and reduction; not a complete pathway

selected_closed_reduction_and_orthopedic: displacement in any direction > two thirds radial shaft width

data.source_evidence_basis: The pathway calls for reduction plus ED orthopaedic review for acute neurovascular compromise and other listed deformity criteria; open fractures warrant ED orthopaedic review. Stable cases are followed in fracture clinic at about one week.
data.limitations: This is a single jurisdiction pathway; thresholds and routes are not universal. The one-week review is a recommendation, not an observed completion time. This extract selects criteria and omits other source referral criteria; it must not be treated as an exhaustive eligibility rule. Source distinguishes orthopedic review from closed reduction AND review.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Branch urgent escalation from findings; keep referral and actual specialist review as separate events. Use the one-week interval only as an external target.
